tools.name: mtr_fare
tools.description: Look up the published MTR fare between two stations in Hong Kong, by station name or MTR station id. Returns the Octopus adult/student/JoyYou-sixty/child/elderly/PWD fares and the single-journey adult fare in HKD, with the open-data source URL. Deterministic: same input, same answer. Read-only. No k

tools.name: subsidy_amount
tools.description: Compute the Hong Kong Public Transport Fare Subsidy Scheme amount for one month, from the expenses recorded under an Octopus account and an AlipayHK account. Rule taken verbatim from the Government page: one-third of the monthly public transport expenses in excess of a $500 threshold, capped at $400

tools.name: log_trip
tools.description: Record one public transport trip (date, from, to, fare, mode, which account paid) so it counts towards a monthly total and the subsidy estimate. Writes to your own ledger; a bearer API key is required and the call counts against the same monthly allowance as the REST endpoint.

tools.name: monthly_summary
tools.description: Totals for one month from the trips you recorded: trip count, total fare, breakdown by mode and by payment account, and the subsidy estimate computed separately for the Octopus and AlipayHK accounts. Requires a bearer API key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "log_trip" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
